run_adsorbml_pipeline: run the AdsorbMLRunner calculate method to find global minima adsorption energy for slab-adsorbate systems
initialize_adsorbml_runner: create an AdsorbMLRunner instance with an ASE calculator, input data path, and relaxation parameters
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file using the write_results method
configure_adsorbml_relaxation: configure AdsorbMLRunner with custom optimizer, force convergence threshold, and number of placements
checkpoint_adsorbml_state: save the AdsorbMLRunner state to a checkpoint location using the save_state method
